title: Hand Contract: Steal a Bell
summary: Silas wants a village bell. Not this village's. Anyone's.

dialogue.intro: A note under your door. Sealed with a golden hand.
offer: 'A bell. From a village that isn't this one. They ring them when we come. I'd like them to stop.'
dialogue.return: Silas is still waiting for his bell.
dialogue.reward: The bell disappears into a sack. A heavy purse appears in its place.
dialogue.done: Somewhere a village can't ring for help. The Hand is pleased.
